summary: the launcher refuses the lazy boundary profile at a site that has not enabled it, and reserves the profile's whole 4 GiB, each fault in a private copy of qemu_profile.c found by the memory rows

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I tests/host -I tools/etude/include -I tools/etude/posix tests/host/etude_qemu_hosttest.c tools/etude/posix/qemu.c tools/etude/capture.c tools/etude/history_json.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/posix/exec.c tools/etude/posix/keeper.c tools/etude/posix/process.c -o ${WORK}/etude_qemu_hosttest

faults.name: unproved-site
faults.summary: the lazy boundary profile is given QEMU at a site that has not enabled it

faults.name: half-reservation
faults.summary: the boundary profile reserves 1 GiB for guest pages in place of 2 GiB
